Question B-005-001-011.

Why the correct answer is right: One millihenry is 1 000 microhenries. 10 000 microhenries divided by 1 000 is 10 mH.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "100 millihenries": That result uses the wrong microhenry-to-millihenry scale, effectively moving 10 000 uH to 100 mH instead of 10 mH.
- sourceIndex 2: "1 millihenry": This is ten times too small.
- sourceIndex 3: "1000 millihenries": This is one hundred times too large.
